title: Pre-Filter Replacement/Cleaning
fullDescription: Honeywell HPA models signal the pre-filter ('A' filter) every 3 months. Some are washable; most carbon pre-filters are disposable.

fixSteps.title: Replace pre-filter
fixSteps.instruction: Slide front cover off, replace pre-filter.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold pre-filter reset button for 2 seconds.

faq.a: Yes, but certified carbon filters give expected results.

title: HEPA Filter Replacement
fullDescription: HEPA indicator lights every 12 months. Replace the R-type filter for HPA300/200/100 series.

fixSteps.title: Replace HEPA
fixSteps.instruction: Remove pre-filter then HEPA. Insert new R filter.

title: Filter Door Open
fullDescription: E1 on newer Honeywell models (HPA5300) indicates filter door interlock is open.

fixSteps.title: Close cover
fixSteps.instruction: Press cover firmly until it clicks.

title: Fan Speed Error
fullDescription: E2 reports the fan is not reaching commanded RPM. Check airflow obstructions and motor.

title: Air Quality Sensor Error
fullDescription: E3 means the dust sensor module is not reporting. Clean lens or replace.

title: Wi-Fi Disconnected
fullDescription: Honeywell Home app requires 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. WF indicates lost connection.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Wi-Fi button and pair via app.

title: Auto Mode Unavailable
shortDescription: Auto mode disabled by sensor fault.
fullDescription: Auto mode requires working air quality sensor. Fix E3 to restore.

title: Dim Mode Active
fullDescription: DIM indicates display is dimmed for nighttime. Press dimmer button to cycle brightness.

faq.a: Yes, cycle through to full off.

title: Fan Noise Abnormal
fullDescription: Noise often comes from loose pre-filter, debris on fan, or worn bearing.

title: Control Lock Active
fullDescription: Control lock prevents accidental button presses. Hold lock button 3 seconds to toggle.
